assumptions: Buses run the same timetable every day; confirm on holidays.
Untimed stops show the terminal departure plus 'passes shortly after'.
'A / B' menu entries mean either dish is served.
Only complaint forms and official role emails are published; no personal phone numbers.

flags.message: Bus 1 sheet subtitle says '29-Seater Non-AC Bus' but its Morning column (7:15–10:45 AM) is a 56-seater. The combined sheet confirms the 56-seater window; Gati uses that.
Bus 2 sheet spells the stop 'JHRA' in its Late Evening column. Treated as JRHA.

The combined sheet header lists the regular route as U Corridor → Research Park Circle → Gate-1 → JRHA, the per-bus sheets as JRHA → Gate-1 → Research Park Circle → U Corridor. Gati reads these as the two directions of the same route.

Times are published only at JRHA and U Corridor (and Mess Parking / Kudasan for the institute bus). Gate 1, Research Park Circle, AB1 Parking and Rakshashakti Circle have no times; Gati shows the terminal departure and says the bus passes shortly after. No times are estimated.

Morning ★ trips are a loop from JRHA via AB1 Parking and Mess Parking to U Corridor and back to JRHA. There are no separate U Corridor departures before 10:30 AM; students at U Corridor in the morning board the ★ loop on its way back to JRHA.

Institute (Kudasan) schedule 'To IITGn' times are read as departures from Kudasan. A 30-minute gap between 'From' and 'To' rows is too short for a full round trip, so they cannot be arrival times at campus.
Arrival times are not published for any route.
Operating days are not stated on any bus sheet. Gati assumes the same timetable every day of the week and tells students to confirm on holidays.
Saturday dinner has no separate non-veg item (Egg Curry is offered as an alternative to Kadhai Paneer).
Dishes written as 'A / B' in the menu are shown as 'A or B' (either one is served).
The menu is a single weekly cycle titled November 2026. Gati applies it to every week from 1 to 30 November 2026 and shows no menu for dates outside that range.
The menu names four messes (Mohani, Jaiswal, Rgouras, Bhopal) but does not say whether menus differ between them. Gati shows one common menu.
Coordinator names and personal phone numbers in the sheet are intentionally not included in the app; only complaint forms and official role emails are.
